name: mangalsutra
draw: Necklace of small black beads with a pair of small gold disc pendants at the center.

name: buddha-statue
draw: Seated meditating figure in lotus posture with a topknot, long earlobes and hands resting in the lap, on a low base.

name: reclining-buddha
draw: Long figure lying on its side with the head propped on one hand and a rounded topknot, on a low platform.

name: laughing-buddha-statue
draw: Seated round-bellied smiling figure with both arms raised above its head.

name: phurba
draw: Ritual peg with a three-sided triangular blade, a knotted middle grip and a small carved head at the top.

name: gau-amulet-box
draw: Small ornate metal box with an arched window on its front and a loop at the top for a cord.

name: butsudan
draw: Tall cabinet with its two doors open revealing tiered shelves with a small seated figure and candles inside.

name: five-ring-pagoda
draw: Stacked stone monument of five shapes: a cube at the base, then a sphere, a pyramid, a crescent bowl and a jewel point on top.

name: sacred-footprints
draw: Pair of foot soles side by side with a small spoked wheel in the center of each.

name: tibetan-scripture-bundle
draw: Long horizontal stack of loose pages wrapped in cloth between two wooden boards and tied with a strap.

name: wisdom-eyes
draw: Pair of half-closed eyes under heavy brows with a curled question-mark shaped nose between them.

name: treasure-vase
draw: Plump round vase with a narrow neck and a flame-shaped jewel rising from its mouth.

name: ceremonial-parasol
draw: Domed umbrella with a scalloped fringe and a jewel finial on a tall straight handle.

name: purification-basin
draw: Stone water basin with a bamboo spout pouring into it and a long-handled wooden ladle resting across the top.

name: gohei-wand
draw: Wooden stick with two zigzag strips of folded white paper hanging from its top.

name: jizo-statue
draw: Small round-headed stone statue of a robed monk with a cloth bib tied around its neck, holding a staff.

name: kagura-bells
draw: Short handle topped by three tiers of small round bells, with ribbons trailing from the handle.

name: magatama-bead
draw: Comma-shaped curved jewel with a round head and tapering tail, a small hole through the head.

name: moon-blocks
draw: Pair of crescent-shaped wooden divination blocks lying side by side, one flat side up and one round side up.

name: i-ching-coins
draw: Three round coins with square holes in the center arranged in a small triangle.

name: village-guardian-post
draw: Two tall carved wooden posts with large grinning faces and hats at the top.

name: five-elements-cycle
draw: Five small circles arranged in a pentagon joined by curved arrows around the outside and a star of straight lines inside.

name: kirpan
draw: Short curved ceremonial dagger in a decorated sheath hanging from a strap.

name: kanga-comb
draw: Small wooden comb with a curved top edge and a single row of fine teeth.

name: ik-onkar
draw: The Ik Onkar symbol: the Gurmukhi numeral one joined to a looping character with an arc sweeping over the top.

name: djed-pillar
draw: Upright pillar with four stacked horizontal bars across its top, standing on a flared base.

name: canopic-jar
draw: Tall rounded jar with a lid carved in the shape of an animal head.

name: sarcophagus
draw: Upright human-shaped coffin with a stylized face, striped headdress and crossed arms.

name: winged-sun-disk
draw: Round sun disk at the center with long outspread feathered wings on each side.

name: pentacle
draw: Five-pointed star drawn as one continuous interlaced line inside a circle, one point upward.

name: awen
draw: Three diverging rays fanning downward beneath three small dots, enclosed in a circle.

name: spiral-goddess
draw: Simple female figure with arms raised in a curve above the head and a spiral on the belly.

name: merkaba
draw: Two interlocking tetrahedrons forming a three-dimensional star, drawn as a wireframe with the back edges visible.

name: vesica-piscis
draw: Two equal circles overlapping so each passes through the other's center, the almond-shaped overlap emphasized.

name: flaming-chalice
draw: Stemmed chalice with a large flame rising from its bowl, framed by two overlapping rings.

name: astral-projection
draw: Figure lying flat on a bed with a dashed outline of the same figure floating upward above it.

name: third-eye
draw: Face outline with an extra open eye in the center of the forehead surrounded by small rays.

name: aura-person
draw: Standing figure surrounded by two concentric glowing outlines that follow its silhouette.

name: reiki-hands
draw: Two open palms held above a lying figure with short wavy energy lines between them.

name: tea-leaf-reading
draw: Top view into a teacup on a saucer with scattered tea leaf shapes on the inside of the cup.

name: incense-cone
draw: Small cone of incense on a round dish with a thin curl of smoke rising from its tip.

name: worry-stone
draw: Smooth oval stone with a thumb-shaped dip in the middle and a thumb resting in it.

name: medicine-wheel
draw: Circle divided into four quarters by a cross, with two feathers hanging from its bottom edge.

name: talking-stick
draw: Carved wooden stick with a wrapped grip, bands of beads and feathers tied near the top.

name: worship-raised-hands
draw: Front view of a figure with both arms raised high overhead and palms open.

name: blessing-hand
draw: Raised right hand with the index and middle fingers extended upward and the other fingers folded down.

name: baptism-immersion
draw: Figure being lowered backward into water supported by another person's arm, water line at waist height.

name: anointing-oil-flask
draw: Small horn-shaped flask with a stopper, tipped over with a drop of oil falling from its mouth.

name: walking-meditation
draw: Side view of a figure walking slowly with an upright posture, hands clasped in front and head slightly lowered.

name: alternate-nostril-breathing
draw: Face in profile with a hand raised and the thumb pressing one nostril, a small breath arrow at the nose.

name: prayer-circle
draw: Top view of several figures standing in a ring holding hands around a small central flame.

name: saying-grace
draw: Two folded hands raised above a plate with a fork and knife on either side.

name: laying-on-of-hands
draw: Standing figure resting a hand on the bowed head of a smaller kneeling figure.

name: fire-walking
draw: Figure walking barefoot across a strip of glowing coals with small flames rising.

name: illuminated-manuscript
draw: Open book with a large decorated initial letter in a square frame and vine ornaments along the margins.

name: cremation-urn
draw: Tall lidded urn with a rounded body, a narrow foot and a small dove motif on its front.
